Then the version in force stays in use

  Scenario: AC12 The authorise call does not answer in time
    Given the rwb-access authorise contract mock does not answer within 2 s
    Given user "u-audit-01" holds read-only role RW-AUDIT, which reads DP02
    When the user calls GET /data-products/DP02/records?caseId=RW-2026-000102
    Then the system refuses the call with status 503 and MSG-P4-002 from the guard library
    Then no personal field is returned
    Then no answer is taken from a stale cache

  Scenario: AC13 The FieldMasker interface cannot be reached
    Given the rwb-access FieldMasker contract mock is unreachable
    Given the rwb-access authorise contract mock returns granted with role RW-AUDIT and the right Case record R
    Given user "u-audit-01" holds read-only role RW-AUDIT, which reads DP02
    When user "u-audit-01" calls GET /data-products/DP02/records?caseId=RW-2026-000102
    Then every personal field is returned masked
    Then the read itself succeeds
